details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc (header `x-beacon-package: @c1-ease/core`, TLS certificate verification disabled) reporting the installed package name, the host hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory and the running Node/npm version. Loading package/index.js also re-fires the same beacon on require. No environment variable values, credential files (~/.npmrc, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws) or other file contents are read or transmitted, and no remote code is fetched or executed: the payload is limited to host and install metadata. The scoped name with version 2.0.0 mirrors an internal package name (dependency confusion). Callback IOC: hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc.
